newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens up as pre-budget squeeze continues.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens up as pre-budget squeeze continues.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started budget day with modest gains, unwilling to give up any part of Tuesday's massive rally as hopes of a favourable fiscal package refused to die.
The index was 9.7 points up at 4,738 by 0733 GMT after yesterday's 2.7 percent for the index.
"The budget will be much more threatening than people expect," said Charterhouse chief economist, Richard Jeffrey.
"There is enough bid speculation around to get market-makers going but the closer the budget gets the fewer bets people will take and it tends to get very quiet on budget days," he said.
